content.comment_body: I'm experiencing issues with the S7Droid app. I believe my setup is correct, but when I try to control inputs through the app, nothing changes on my panel with indicator lights. My local network uses a linksys router with [product_name], and I can download and send programs to [product_name], as well as run simulations. The S7Droid app connects to [product_name], but I still can't control inputs from my phone. Could someone clarify the correct way to configure this? I have searched extensively but haven't found a solution yet. Any assistance would be greatly appreciated, as this is important for my thesis. I've also included some screenshots for reference.

Hi, you can't directly control inputs! Regardless of whether something is connected or not, the signal will remain zero unless a sensor or device is physically attached. Instead, modify your program to use a digital network input with a Vx.y address, which you can control via the app. [product_name] will respond to this input if it's integrated into your program. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user tried to control input signals on [product_name] using the S7Droid mobile app and was unsuccessful. The main issue is a misunderstanding—the hardware only allows monitoring of input signals, not remote control via software. Remote control is possible using a digital network input, a feature not immediately obvious during initial setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated being able to directly control physical inputs on [product_name] from a mobile app via a local network.
